title: Settlement for Devices That Never Reached the Dock on a Northbeam Renew Trade-In Batch
content:
The transit settlement covers the devices the shipment request declared that were never booked in, and the value of each device is the amount quoted spread over the devices the request declared. The devices the request declared are the units declared on the latest shipment request standing on the Northbeam Renew Trade-In agreement; the devices short are those declared less those booked in, never fewer than none; and the value of each device is the amount quoted on the agreement divided by the devices the request declared, rounded to the cent.

| Devices booked in against devices declared | The value of each device against the programme's transit cover | The transit settlement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| fewer booked in than declared | at or above the transit cover | the programme's transit cover for each device short |
| fewer booked in than declared | below the transit cover | the value of each device for each device short |
| every device declared was booked in | either way | nothing |

**Both sides of the cover.** A value of each device standing at exactly the programme's transit cover is at that cover, so the settlement is the cover for each device short and not the value of each device; the two come to the same figure at that point. A value one cent below the cover is below it, and the settlement follows the value of each device.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A shipment request declaring 16 devices on an agreement quoted at 9600.00 USD gives a value of each device of 600.00 USD. Where 12 devices were booked in, 4 devices are short. Against a hypothetical transit cover of 1500.00 USD the value of each device is below the cover, so the settlement is 600.00 USD for each of the 4 devices short, or 2400.00 USD. Against a hypothetical transit cover of 400.00 USD the value of each device is above the cover, so the settlement is 400.00 USD for each of the 4 devices short, or 1600.00 USD. Where all 16 devices were booked in, nothing is settled on this account.
